These operators define a closed-loop system where each primitive acts as a constraint on the next. The mutual information score I(score;Y|q) serves as a signal-to-noise ratio, while the placebo gate enforces that any observed effect is not due to chance. Leakage detection ensures that no future information enters the model, maintaining causality. Together, they constitute a minimal but sufficient set of criteria for phase-zero feature acceptance in NFL data pipelines.
